tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ thams cad rig pa'i brgyud yig gsol 'debs su sbyar ba bzhugs/

na mo gu ru/ thams cad rig pa'i rgyud 'debs bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo// yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam snang mdzad/ /rigs kun 'khor los bsgyur ba rdo rje sems/ /gsang bdag rnam 'phrul in+d+ra bhu ti'i zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so snying nas skyabs su mchi/ /rnal 'byor ma dpal ka ma la pa dang// bde ba'i rdo rje nor bu gling pa'i zhabs/ /de nyid bcu mkhyen shrad+dha ka ra'i mtshan// gus pa'i phyag 'tshal bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /sgra bsgyur kun kyi mchog gyur rin chen bzang*/ /legs pa'i shes rab blo gsal kun gyi phul/ /cho ga'i mthar son sum ston ye shes 'bar/ /yang yang gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes bzung*/ /gnyan ston tshul 'bar rtog dpyod pha mthar son/ /yo ga rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag dben rtsa grags/ /'dus pa'i bdag po thod pa 'od zer la/ /mchog tu mos pa'i phyag 'tshal byin gyis rlobs/ /chen po'i gtsug rgyan rong pa chos mgon dang*/ /bod yul chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i mtshan/ / mkhas pa'i mkhas pa rdo rje shes rab ste/ /ngo mtshar bla ma gsum la snying nas dad/ /byin rlabs gzi ldan bla ma 'phags rgyal dang*/ /de yi thugs sras rin chen dpal bzang dang*/ /skye rgu'i gtsug rgyan bsod nams rgyal mtshan la/ / dad pa rnam gsum stobs su gyur pas 'dud/ /gdams ngag rgya mtsho kun mkhyen gangs khrod pa/ /'jam dbyangs bdun par grags pa theg chen rje/ /gang des rjes bzung brag thog bsod nams bzang*/ /de dag rnams la'ang phyag 'tshal byin gyis rlobs/ /'jig med dpa' bo kun dga' rnam rgyal zhabs/ /smra ba'i dbang po byang chub dbang rgyal dang*/ /zab don nyams zhes shākya kun dga'i zhabs/ /brgyud ldan de dag rnams la'ang gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rje 'dzin dbang ye shes dbang po dang*/ /brgyud pa kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /'gro kun dga' mdzad snying po'i zhabs la yang*/ /gsol ba 'debs so phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/

£¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ slob dpon dam pa kun dga' chos bsam pa/ /dngos rgyud bla ma snying po byang chub zhabs/ /snying po 'phrin las kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so snying nas skyabs su mchi £© /bde gshegs rnams kyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs dang*/ /phyag rgya sngags dang ting 'dzin cho ga'i mthus// ngan song rgyud kyi 'gro ba ma lus pa'i/ /sdug bsngal mod la zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'gro gnas drug tu 'khor ba'i sems can rnams/ /dkyil 'khor chen po rtag tu mngon sum mthong*/ /de ma thag tu gzungs dang ting 'dzin dang*/ / yon tan mtha' yas thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /ye shes dbang bskur bye ba phrag brgya thob/ /don dam dkyil 'khor lha dang skal mnyam gyur/ /rigs pa 'dzin pa'i sa rnams rab rdzogs nas/ /thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas thob shog / 'di ni yo ga stod lugs smad lugs gnyis 'dus kyi dbang du byas/ bdag skyed rgyas pa dang 'brel che ba'i brgyud pa yin la/ spyir stod lugs smad lugs zhes pa'i tha snyad rdor dbyings nyid kyi cho ga'i dbye ba yin mod kyang*/ de'i mdangs zhig sbyong rgyud kyi cho ga la yang cung zad shar ba'o/ /rnal 'byor ma ka ma la pa ni/ ka ma la pa ti'o/ /in+d+ra bhū ti dang de'i bar du lcam lak+ṣa mā dang*/ don zhags pa 'jug pa'ang yod de dgos nges ma yin no/ /dben rtsa grags zhes pa'ang thod pa dben rtsa grags te thod pa 'od zer de'i dpon po'o/ / lugs de gnyis la mi the ba sa lugs kyi rgyud rim ni/ phyag rdor/ rab gsal zla ba/ rab 'byor skyangs/ kun snying/ shes rab skyangs/ zhi ba snying po/ dge mtshan bshes gnyen/ zhes rgya gar pa'i rgyud pa 'ded cing*/ de rjes nor bu gling pa/ shrad+dha/ lo chen phrag stengs pa/ mal lo/ sa skya gong ma bzhi/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ ti shrī kun blo/ chos rje bla ma/ gangs khrod pa man chad gong dang 'dra/ sa lugs nang sel/

ngor lugs ltar na/ bla ma dam pa'i ri khrod pa blo brtan/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ dpal ldan rdo rje/ kun dga' mchog grub/ rje grol mchog /rje brtsun rdo rings pa kun dga'i mtshan can/ de'i drung du bdag gis bka' thob/ yang ngor chen/ kha char ba/ pan chen shākya mchog ldan/ /mtha' gong pa thugs rje dpal/ rje grol mchog /ces ded kyang chog go / yang bo dong ba'i lugs ltar na/ ring rgyud bla ma dam pa/ byang rtse grags rgyal/ /rje chos rgyal ba nyid ces rgyud pa 'ded la/ nye rgyud rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyis gnang ba sbyin nas/ /pan chen 'jigs med grags pa/ sngags ram pa 'jam grags/ slob dpon bkra shis grags pa/ /slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rnam rgyal/ de la bdag gis nos pa lags/ / mkhas mchog bu ston nas rgyud pa ni/ stod lugs/ smad lugs so so dang*/ gcig tu 'dres pa dang*/ de dag gis nang sel rtsa bsnur 'dzims sogs so sor rgyud pa dang*/ jo bo lugs rigs gnyis/ zang dkar lugs/ sa lugs/ kha che lugs/ chag lugs sogs rgyud pa mi 'dra ba shin tu mang po so sor gsan nas gcig tu 'dus pa yin/ de rnams so so'i rgyud yig shin tu mang po dag yi ges 'jigs te 'dir ma bris/ shes par 'dod na gsan yig tu ltos/ de phyin chad ni thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston/ thugs sras lo tsā ba/ 'jam dbyangs grags rgyal/ 'khrul zhig tshul rgyal/ mkhyen rab chos rje/ chos rig pa/ dbon po rin chen rgyal po/ rje byang gling pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dam pa dpal ldan chos bzang*/ rnams rgyud nas dngos kyis 'khums so/ /jo bo rje'i rang bzhed sbyong rgyud lugs kun rig dkar po'i rgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan shākya seng ge 'gro ba'i skyabs/ /gsang gsum bdag po phyag na rdo rje dang*/ /mkhas mchog dzñā na shrī mi tra dang*/ /byang chub sems kyi mnga' bdag a ti sha

/gus pas skyabs su mchi'o byin gyis rlobs/ /rigs sngags grub pa go mi sgom chen dang*/ /sngags rgyud rig pa skyi nor dzñā na'i zhabs/ / brtson pa mthar phyin gnyal pa nyi she ba/ /mos gus mthar phyin snur ston sing ha'i zhabs/ /gus pas skyabs su mchi'o byin gyis rlobs/ /sprul ston 'bar thog srung ma bran du 'khol/ /mthu stobs che ldan yang dag rdo rje rtsangs/ de sras 'byung gnas seṅge mkhas pa'i phul/ /'phrin las mchog gyur mdo sde seṅge la/ / gus pas skyabs su mchi'o byin gyis rlobs/ /bskal bzang sems dpa' lung bstan chos sku 'od/ /gsang sngags bdag po blo ldan seng ge lce/ /rmad byung lce ston bsod nams dpal bzang dang*/ de sras mkhas mchog dbang phyug badz+ra la/ gus pas skyabs su mchi'o byin gyis rlobs/ /mkhas btsun grags ldan mkhan chen rin rgyal ba/ /dkon mchog bzang po 'jam dbyangs dngos byon tshul/ /mkhan chen chos dbang nges don bstan pa 'dzin/ /kun dga' dpal 'byor che rgu'i gtsug na mdzes/ /gus pas skyabs su mchi'o byin gyis rlobs/ /nyams rtogs mthar phy-in bkra shis rnam rgyal dang*/ /gnas lugs gzigs pa lung rig rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ /phyogs 'dzin rdzun dang g.yo zol ma yin pa'i/ rdo rje slob dpon yin nges sgrol ba'i mgon/ gus pas skyabs su mchi'o byin gyis rlobs/ / 'dir dpe mang po na jo bo'i slob ma go bi sgom chen zer te/ la la ru go mi zer ba dag / snur seng ha'i ming nyi ma seng ge'o/ /yang dag sogs ni/ rtsangs yang dag rdo rje'o/ /mdo sde seng ge yang lce ston yin/ mkhan chen rin chen rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' dpal 'byor ba ni/ chos lung tshogs pa'i mkhan po'o/ /yang kun rigs lugs kyi nang sel grags che ba/ gzhan phan snying por grags pa dang*/ brag nag pa lugs ni yi ge de de'i stengs nas dgos su ma thob kyang snga ma la 'dus so/ /ces bya'o/

/ de ltar na ngan song sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad rig pa'i dbang rgyud man ngag rgyud yig gsol 'debs su sbyar ba 'di yang*/ slob bu dam pa yol mkhan po blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis bskul nas/ kun dga' snying po smras pa'o// // gcig zhus// maṅga laṃ// mes pa'o shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/thams cad rig pa'i brgyud yig gsol 'debs su sbyar ba bzhugs so/ / -PAGE 212--PAGE 211--PAGE 210-
